places.name: apartment
observations: Author dropped off dry cleaning and went grocery shopping as errands.
Author bought a deep green rug for the living room that made the apartment feel warmer.
Pepper claimed the new rug and did a slow roll to mark territory.
Author made roasted chicken thighs with lemon and potatoes for dinner.
Author ate dinner at the table instead of the couch.
Author watched an old movie during dinner.
Pepper knocked a water glass off the nightstand at 2am.
Author cleaned up the spilled water half asleep while Pepper watched.
